content: { "rules": [ "Model forecasts undershoot prices during upticks by ~0.5-1.0 on positive sentiment", "Model fails to capture price acceleration on strong buying sentiment (0.67-1.00)", "Sentiment neutrality (0.00) causes model to forecast near-current levels, missing 24-48h momentum", "When prices consolidate, model underforecasts volatility by 10-20% compared to true outcomes", "Negative sentiment (-0.33) causes 0.5-1.0 point forecast bias below actual troughs", "Model mean-reverts to fast-moving prices, creating 1-2 day lag that gets corrected by sentiment momentum", "When sentiment flips from positive to negative, model delays by 3-5 forecast steps" ] }
